rows.corpus_definition: Something that causes you to feel physical hurt.
rows.example_en: Walking is still very painful for him.

rows.corpus_definition: a sudden strong feeling of great fear you cannot control
rows.example_en: A sudden loud noise caused panic in the crowd.

rows.corpus_definition: A box or large package wrapped in paper to be sent away.
rows.example_en: The postman brought a large parcel for me.

rows.corpus_definition: to touch someone gently and quickly with a flat hand
rows.example_en: She patted the dog gently on its head.

rows.corpus_definition: A small piece of material used to fix a hole.
rows.example_en: He put a patch on his torn jeans.

rows.corpus_definition: The ability to stay calm while waiting for something to happen.
rows.example_en: You need a lot of patience to teach young children.

rows.corpus_definition: To stop an activity for a short time.
rows.example_en: Please pause the movie for a moment.

rows.corpus_definition: to return money that you borrowed from someone
rows.example_en: I will pay back the money tomorrow.

rows.corpus_definition: The type of character a person has.
rows.example_en: She has a very outgoing and friendly personality.

rows.corpus_definition: The activity of taking and creating pictures with a camera.
rows.example_en: She enjoys photography and travels to take pictures.
